title: Personal Financial Management: Achieving Your Financial Goals
description: Personal Financial Management provides you with tools and techniques to monitor, evaluate, and control your finances as you work towards achieving your financial goals. You'll learn to actively organize your finances, develop clear paths to your objectives, and successfully attain them. Topics covered include budgeting, assessing the time-value of money, tax planning, loan management, health and asset insurance, and investment strategies for lifelong financial security.
